snippet.title: SacriFire - Official Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
Developer Pixelated Milk introduces new gameplay segments for its upcoming RPG, SacriFire in a new trailer that debuted during the FGS LIve From gamescom latam 2025 showcase. Sacrifire features a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Coming to PC, PS4, PS5. Xbox One and Switch in Q1 2026.
